title: pgvideo semantic content review, version 1
description: A separate review of one accepted storyboard against the original evidence, made without the writer's self-assessment. It judges the video as a whole (`overall`, `editorial`, `coverage`) and has one finding for every target: each narration item, screen heading and line, diagram node and edge, code or table excerpt, glossary card, and manually written TTS text. `pgvideo review-input` writes a template with every target, section, and check still `pending`; a file that still holds a `pending` value is not a finished review. pgvideo checks the coverage, resolves every evidence ID, and decides the content gate; the reviewer's words are findings, never statuses.

separation.description: How the review was kept apart from the writing pass

overall.description: Judgments of the whole video, made after reading the complete script in playback order and before the per-target findings. A failed check blocks delivery; name the scenes in its message.

answer.description: The video states the page's question and gives the main answer early, as the page states it

objectives.description: What the video says and shows meets every learning objective in the plan view

order.description: The order teaches: every term and fact arrives before a scene relies on it

repetition.description: No fact or definition is explained in full more than once, apart from the question, the main answer, and one closing takeaway

caveats.description: Every required caveat and every qualification the kept claims need is still in the video

scope.description: The video keeps the requested detail, audience, and length, and takes nothing from outside the document and allowed glossary

visuals.description: Across the video the screens support the narration: the layouts fit, and nothing shown contradicts what is said

closing.description: The video ends with a supported takeaway and the credits

carried.description: Written by `pgvideo review-input`, never by hand: the findings copied unchanged from the review of an earlier storyboard of this request, because what those targets show or say, their claims, and the evidence did not change. pgvideo verifies each one on import.

factual.description: Whether the target states technical content, judged independently of its origin label

scene.description: The scene the finding is about, or `*` for the whole video

related.description: The other scenes a finding involves, such as the scene that repeats a fact or the one a term is needed in
